cases.name: Kishana Harley
cases.about:
She had a reputation as a fierce advocate against police brutality and gun violence and was passionate about social justice reform.

In 2019, in her memory, the Richmond City Council passed a measure condemning “racial injustice and police brutality,” which was partially written by her.
